validity_findings: C1-FRESHNESS-NON304: Freshness phase observations use only 2 endpoint paths (/api/profile, /api/data_list). Preregistration requires 'distinct URIs>10 skew>0.90' for C1. The sticky check (V-DISTRIBUTED-STICKINESS) separately validates 12 distinct URIs (with query params) at 1.0 consistency, but the freshness data itself does not exercise >10 distinct URIs. This is a representation limitation: C1 gate passes on counts but the distinct-URI diversity claim rests on infrastructure validation, not freshness observations.

C3-HONEST-COST: Trajectory-block permutation mixes 91 'fresh_*' trajectories (honest_cost 58-68, mean ~64) with 480 'jaccard_pair_*' trajectories (honest_cost 2-4, mean ~2.7). Cost is primarily determined by trajectory type, not f. The block permutation across heterogeneous types reduces power to detect within-type bijective artifacts. Test passes (|rho_shuffled|=0.0319, p=0.297) but may not validate honest-cost integrity within each trajectory type.

C4-FULL-VECTOR: Body-varying (80 pairs, A vs C) and header-varying (80 pairs, valid vs expired) sub-comparisons have degenerate bootstrap CIs (width=0.0, effective_distinct_n=2) because only 2 distinct groups exist per sub-comparison. Main pooled full-vector CI is non-degenerate (width=0.1143, effective_n=4). Sub-comparison CIs should not be interpreted as precise estimates.

C5-HIT: Warm request returned X-Cache=EXPIRED (expected: /health location uses proxy_cache_valid 200 1m; Phase-0 health gate cached /health >1m before Phase-5 warm request). All 330 subsequent requests are genuine HIT with byte-identical greedy-decompressed bodies. This is correctly noted in validity_notes.
Scope limitation: Experiment covers plain HTTP localhost only. TLS, HTTP/2, multi-host, BrowserGym/CDP, SPA write-paths are NOT tested (acknowledged in provenance.scope).
baseline_findings: B-FULL-VECTOR-STABLE: full=0.7619 (CI [0.7048, 0.819], width=0.1143, effective_n=4) >0.5 and >max(body,status)+0.05 (diff_lo=0.319). Null FP=0.0. PASSES as primary intervention baseline.
B-BODY-ONLY: body-only discrimination=0.381 on pooled pairs. On body-varying probes: 1.0 (perfect). On header-varying probes: 0.0 (no false positive). PASSES as manipulation check.
B-STATUS-ONLY: status-only discrimination=0.0 on all probe types. PASSES as manipulation check.

B-HEADER-ONLY-JACCARD-STABLE: Primary structural baseline for orthogonality. Mean=0.4643, var=0.0958, drift_mean=0.2857, no_drift_mean=1.0, |r_sched|=0.0087, V=0.0379, nullFP=0.0, same-state J=1.0. PASSES all criteria.

B-HEADER-NAME-ONLY: Diagnostic baseline. Mean=0.85, var=0.0075, drift_mean=0.8, no_drift_mean=1.0, nullFP=0.0. Lower separation than value-stable Jaccard (0.8 vs 0.2857 drift mean) but valid null. Diagnostic only, not gating.
B-HEADER-HASH-REJECTED: Negative control. Confirms body-derived headers excluded from structural representation. PASSES (surrogate not used).
B-COST-SHUFFLED: |rho_shuffled|=0.0319, p=0.297. Same computation as C3. PASSES.
B-HEADERS-NO-BODYDERIVED-STABLE: Body-varying body-only=1.0, header-varying body-only=0.0, header-varying full=1.0. PASSES as isolated signal validation.
NC-ORTHOGONALITY-NOISE-STABLE: Same-state Jaccard mean=1.0, nullFP=0.0. PASSES.
NC-HIT-NULL: HIT 330/330 byte-identical after greedy decompression. PASSES.
NC-FACTORY-REGRESSION: WSGI factory pattern verified (sys.path insert before import). PASSES.
NC-SYNTHETIC-MUTATION-ABSENCE: Scoped grep confirms no uuid.uuid4() in executable header path; HMAC-SHA256 deterministic. PASSES.
NC-EXCLUSIVE-NGINX: Single nginx master via -c /tmp/single.db.nginx.conf, cache enabled, perms valid. PASSES.
V-SAME-STATE-J: Same-state Jaccard J=1.0 exactly. PASSES.
V-RECOMPUTE-MISMATCHES: 0 mismatches across all recomputed metrics (Jaccard, scheduling r, Cramers V, honest cost rho, full-vector, HIT). PASSES.

unresolved: C1 distinct-URI diversity within freshness observations: whether >10 distinct URIs must be exercised in the freshness phase itself or if infrastructure validation via sticky check is sufficient for canonical claim.

C3 honest-cost trajectory-type confound: whether mixing fresh_* (high cost) and jaccard_pair_* (low cost) trajectories in block permutation adequately tests bijective artifact within each type, or if separate per-type permutation is needed for stronger guarantee.

C4 sub-comparison CI degeneracy: whether body-varying and header-varying bootstrap CIs with effective_n=2 and width=0.0 should be reported or suppressed given only 2 distinct groups per sub-comparison.
